de-berlin-bed-springs-tower.label: Bed-spring tower
de-berlin-bed-springs-tower.name: Bergholzstrasse bed-spring Eiffel replica, Berlin
de-berlin-bed-springs-tower.summary: At Bergholzstrasse 11, repeated bed-spring coils form an Eiffel outline, covering the splayed legs, platforms and upper framework. Jon Worth recounts finding it on a neighbourhood walk during pandemic restrictions; the discovery started his worldwide replica inventory. The account documents its discovery. The maker, build year, photograph's capture date and current permanence remain unknown.

kr-seoul-tower-at-the-roadside.label: Seoul
kr-seoul-tower-at-the-roadside.name: Seoul signage-shop forecourt Eiffel replica
kr-seoul-tower-at-the-roadside.summary: April 2018 Street View records a golden-yellow Eiffel-shaped model outside a Seoul shop advertising signs and LED-related services. It stands at the edge of the paved forecourt, with four legs, a lower arch and two small open platforms visible. This establishes a commercial display setting; the shop's formal name, the tower's maker and whether the shop made or sold it remain unconfirmed. The imagery date is not a construction date or proof of its present location.

it-ispra-jrc-ispra-grounds.label: JRC Ispra
it-ispra-jrc-ispra-grounds.name: JRC Ispra lawn Eiffel replica
it-ispra-jrc-ispra-grounds.summary: A light beige Eiffel replica stands on a lawn inside the Joint Research Centre fence beside Via E. Fermi in Ispra. September 2025 Street View confirms its broad lower arch, two small platforms and slender upper shaft. The close wire mesh belongs to the site fence, not the tower. Its setting is a research-campus lawn; the maker, installation year and public access conditions remain unknown. The tower mentioned in a 2009 French Semester sponsorship document has not been established as the same object.

fr-nuits-s-armancon-tower-in-a-yard.label: Nuits
fr-nuits-s-armancon-tower-in-a-yard.name: Nuits courtyard Eiffel replica
fr-nuits-s-armancon-tower-in-a-yard.summary: This grey replica stands between stone houses in a private Nuits courtyard, among plants, parasols and a pedal boat. Jon Worth's photograph shows a slender lattice shaft, two railed platforms and a red component inside the open top frame. The original file records 14 July 2023 as the capture date; some feet are obscured by garden objects. Its visible role is courtyard decoration. The maker, construction year, public access and current condition remain unconfirmed.
